title: mirql Outcome v1
description: Canonical attempt outcome: the signed result of executing a job under a warrant — evidence, anti-cheat results, change surface, thrift and cost reconciliation. Every number in the document must be a safe integer (Law 17); money is integer micro-USD.

warrant_id.description: ULID of the warrant the job executed under.

epoch.description: Configuration epoch the attempt ran under.

status.description: Terminal status of the attempt, e.g. `pass`, `fail`, `blocked`, `needs_human`.

base_sha.description: SHA-256 of the base commit the attempt started from (must equal job.base_sha).

head_sha.description: SHA-256 of the produced head commit.

tree_hash.description: Content hash of the produced working tree (mergeproof witness).

evidence.description: Test runs, logs and measurements proving the outcome; integer-only numbers (Law 17).

anti_cheat.description: Anti-cheat scan results (diff scoped to warrant, no test weakening, ...); integer-only numbers (Law 17).

phi.description: Sensitive-data (PHI) handling record: scanned, leaked, redactions applied; integer-only numbers (Law 17).

surface.description: Change surface touched by the attempt (files_changed, lines_added, lines_removed); integer-only numbers (Law 17).

thrift.description: Resource thrift metrics (model_calls, tokens_in, tokens_out, cache hits); integer-only numbers (Law 17).

reconciliation.description: Ledger reconciliation for the attempt (entries counted, balanced); integer-only numbers (Law 17).

cost.description: Final cost of the attempt, `micro_usd` in integer micro-USD against warrant.budget_micro_usd.
